title: Bedside shelf 10x15x5 cm, board thickness 4 cm
author: user_2407707011
description:
Here you can download a box that makes life easier, especially for every woman, but of course also for men. Simply print and hang it at the head of the bed (board thickness approx. 4 cm), then you can put your creams and anything else you need in bed in it. With a size of 5x10x15, there is also plenty of space.

This is already the 2nd version, first I made holes in it, which in my opinion puts more strain on the printer than simply using a little less infill.

Since not every bed board is the same thickness, feel free to edit the file. If you make other changes, please let me know by commenting or uploading your version.

I printed it with PLA and it worked well.

Have fun!

bedside accessories bedside bedhead bed tray bettablage stabil

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
